summary: Independent exact-MLIR reproduction confirms embedded LLVM e2a39f504fee836e4def9581bed817ecc327b9dc drops sgpr_512 sub4/sub5 during greedy live-range splitting. Final ISA spills undefined s60/s61 and 16 buffer loads use descriptor bases derived from those lanes. This report does not claim a FlyDSL fix.

tests.what_was_measured: Exact MLIR SHA-256 5ca5000c...297ef emitted matching ISA SHA-256 1452f523...4cef with the missing s[60:61] copy.
Failing-before regression: missing s_mov_b64 s[60:61], s[80:81], all eight spill writes present, and exactly 16 affected descriptor loads.
Complete pre-greedy MachineIR shows defined %72:sgpr_512 from kernarg offset 248 and direct sub4/sub5 uses; process segfaulted after the complete dump while unwinding the print option.

Complete post-greedy MachineIR shows copy-in omitting sub4/sub5, whole-register spill/restore, then copy-out and consumption of sub4/sub5; process segfaulted after the complete dump while unwinding the print option.

tests.command: embedded codegen controls with no waves-per-EU option and --amdgpu-waves-per-eu=2
tests.what_was_measured: Both controls emitted the same failing ISA SHA-256 1452f523...4cef.
Affected sibling contains undefined s60/s61 writes at 0x2510/0x2518; clean sibling's corresponding spill group uses defined s12-s27 values.

gpu_execution_evidence: Compile-only and static MachineIR/ISA analysis. The affected kernel was deliberately not executed because its descriptor base is undefined.
remaining_limitations: No corrected LLVM candidate was available, so the required failing-before/passing-after regression is preserved but has no honest passing-after result.
The correction must be made and validated in the pinned LLVM AMDGPU greedy allocator/SplitKit dependency; no FlyDSL-side compiler fix was identified.
The complete MachineIR dumps were produced, but setting the temporary LLVM print option caused an exit-139 teardown after the dump, preventing an independent verifier-success claim.
No GPU numerical result was collected because executing this proven-unsafe object was prohibited and could access an unintended allocation.
